name: miaai-lab/glm-5.3-flash-dgx-sparks-1104
title: MiaAI Lab GLM-5.3-Flash recipe update for 2x DGX Sparks (TensorFold)
summary: MiaAI Lab shipped recipe 1104 for GLM-5.3-Flash on two DGX Sparks over ConnectX-7 with TensorFold 1.1.9. It reports tool-eval hard-mode 93 with thinking on, 380k-token chats resuming in about 3 seconds instead of 4 minutes, optional WITH_VIDEO=1 image input, and a JSON ID bugfix, with measured tok/s tables in the repo.
